name: airport_id
description: Identificador numérico do aeroporto atribuído pelo US DOT
observations: Joins to origin_airport_id and destination_airport_id in `flight`.
description_en: Numeric US DOT identifier of the airport
description_es: Identificador numérico del aeropuerto asignado por el US DOT

name: state_abbreviation
description: Sigla do estado ou território dos Estados Unidos
observations: Filled only for airports in the United States and its territories; null for foreign airports, which carry country_name instead.
description_en: Abbreviation of the US state or territory
description_es: Sigla del estado o territorio de los Estados Unidos

name: country_name
description: País do aeroporto quando situado fora dos Estados Unidos
observations: Null for US airports, which carry state_abbreviation instead.
description_en: Country of the airport when located outside the United States
description_es: País del aeropuerto cuando se ubica fuera de los Estados Unidos

name: airport_description
description: Descrição do aeroporto exatamente como publicada pelo BTS
observations: Kept verbatim so the parsed columns can always be audited against the source.
description_en: Airport description exactly as published by BTS
description_es: Descripción del aeropuerto exactamente como la publica el BTS
